title: A Will for the Cipher
author: Ivo Whitlock
blurb: Isandro Marchetti, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the trial begins.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
